description: A resolved config with a trailing-zero Decimal: answer_tolerance "0.0100", numerically the shipped 0.01, with two trailing zeros. Canonical JSON writes a Decimal as its exact string (R0.4.3), so the config hash covers "0.0100"; the hash oracle checks that rule through the real sealing path, and a runner that wrote str(d.normalize()) ("0.01") fails it, as does one that normalised only small exponents (this value's is -4).
exercises: R0.4.3 canonical JSON of a Decimal with a trailing zero
